name: ui-web
summary: The web API (REST and WebSocket) for the apps OxidePM manages.
description: Serves a REST API and a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:9615 for showing, restarting, stopping and reloading the apps that list ui-web under adapters. Every request, loopback included, needs an access key that is generated into its config.toml the first time it starts; the Host and Origin headers are checked; the WebSocket carries the daemon's lifecycle events. By default it cannot create or delete apps or flush logs. There is no TLS: put a proxy in front for anything but a trusted network.

verbs.name: web
verbs.summary: Show where the web API listens; print or replace its access key.
